bass.tags: Ambient drone with cinematic sound design. A low-frequency sub-bass foundation sustains a constant pedal tone. Granular synthesis creates a shifting texture of metallic scrapes and resonant hums. High-frequency crystalline pings and digital artifacts enter sporadically with long reverb tails. A slow, rhythmic pulsing occurs through sidechain compression on a white noise floor. Pitch-shifted mechanical whirs and industrial atmosphere layers evolve through automated low-pass filter sweeps. The arrangement features no melodic movement or percussive transients, focusing on timbral evolution and spatial depth. 60 BPM, C minor.

[Outro]

drums.tags: Ambient drone with cinematic soundscapes. The piece features a deep, resonant sub-bass foundation that provides a constant low-frequency floor. Layered over this are granular synthesis textures and evolving pads that shift in timbre through slow filter sweeps and long-tail reverb. High-frequency metallic resonances and shimmering bell-like tones appear sporadically, processed through delay and pitch-shifting effects to create a sense of vast acoustic space. The composition lacks a traditional rhythmic pulse or percussion, relying instead on the intersection of harmonic overtones and slow-moving volume swells. Key is C minor. Tempo is 60 BPM. Time signature is 4/4. The arrangement is characterized by the gradual introduction of dissonant clusters that resolve into open fifths.

[Section A]
[granular textures emerge, slow resonant filter sweep]
[metallic shimmering tones with long-tail reverb]

[Section B]
[harmonic overtones intensify, volume swells on mid-range pads]
[pitch-shifted bell-like resonances]

[Outro]
[high frequencies fade, sub-bass drone lingers and slowly decays]

vocals.tags: Dark ambient and cinematic drone. The track is built around a low-frequency, resonant sub-bass foundation that remains static. Layered above are metallic, shimmering textures and granular synthesis pads that slowly evolve with long attack and release times. High-pitched, dissonant sine wave clusters create a sense of tension, occasionally modulated by a slow LFO. A deep, cavernous reverb with a long decay tail is applied to all elements, creating a vast spatial image. There is no rhythmic pulse or percussive element. The harmonic content is microtonal and non-diatonic, shifting through dense clusters of sound. Key: C minor. Tempo: 60 BPM.
